term: episode occurs at a world (OccursAt v e)
definition: OccursAt v e: the episode e occurs in the complete world v of the Ontic frame. A world-indexed refinement of the unindexed Occurs (DEF-EPISODE-OCCURRENCE). Example: my present judging occurs at the actual world. In Lean a parameter W -> Episode -> Prop; no link to Occurs is built in.
